fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.instructions: Fallback used by the Contact Section wherever it's rendered outside the block editor (e.g. the Author page) instead of a page-specific block instance.
fields.default_value: Let’s discuss your great ideas together

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.default_value: Let’s talk about your iGaming business. Please complete the form, and our team will reach out to you as soon as possible.

fields.label: Process Steps
fields.name: contact_steps
fields.instructions: Shown as the 4-step timeline in the Contact Section's left column, on every page — one shared process, not editable per page.

default_value.text: We will process your request within 1-2 business days.
Get back to you with an offer based on your project's scope and requirements.
Set a call to discuss your future project in detail and finalize the offer.
Sign a contract with you to start working on your project.

fields.label: CTA Title
fields.name: cta_title
fields.default_value: Not sure what you need yet?

fields.label: CTA Description
fields.name: cta_description
fields.default_value: Book a quick intro call to explore WheelLab's iGaming expertise and see how we can support your next project.

fields.label: CTA Button
fields.name: contact_cta_button
fields.instructions: Button text comes from the link's own title (e.g. "Book a meeting"). Separate from the header's "Book a Call" link — leave empty to hide the CTA card.

fields.label: Contact Form 7 Shortcode
fields.name: form_shortcode
fields.instructions: Paste the Contact Form 7 shortcode, e.g. [contact-form-7 id="123" title="Contact form"].

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.name: webhook_url
fields.instructions: Every successful contact form submission is forwarded here as JSON (in addition to the normal CF7 email). Leave empty to disable forwarding.
